advisorFindings.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
advisorFindings.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
advisorFindings.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

availableToolLimitation: Connected Supabase tools have no Auth configuration or project backup endpoint. No Supabase management token or privileged database binding is configured.

documentation.requirement: Leaked password protection is available on the Pro Plan and above.

nextAction: The project owner must enable the eligible plan and Auth setting, or provide approved administrative configuration access after upgrading. Recheck the advisor and approved local/test auth flow afterward; no plan upgrade is currently authorized.
